Class TransportType

java.lang.Object
fr.robie.machineengine.api.network.TransportType
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
public final class TransportType extends Object implements net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed
A kind of transport block, e.g. a cable or pipe (ARCHITECTURE.md §15). Adjacent transports of the same NetworkType form one network; the network moves at most the lowest ratePerTick() of its transports, and only what filter() accepts.
